claims.claim_text: The section summarises the metrics used to measure and monitor sustainability-related risks and opportunities (including climate-related metrics and targets) and how performance is tracked against those targets.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Metrics and targets (intro paragraph)
claims.support_notes: Describes scope/purpose; not a specific IFRS disclosure requirement mapping.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses metrics required by applicable IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "We disclose: metrics required by applicable IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards"
claims.support_notes: Statement aligns with IFRS S1 paragraph 46(a); no specific metric list provided here.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses the metrics it uses to measure and monitor each sustainability-related risk or opportunity.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "the metrics we use to measure and monitor: each sustainability-related risk or opportunity"
claims.support_notes: High-level commitment; does not enumerate risk/opportunity-specific metrics in this excerpt.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses metrics used to monitor performance in relation to sustainability-related risks and opportunities, including progress towards targets set and any targets required by law or regulation.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "our performance... including progress towards targets... and any targets required by law or regulation"
claims.support_notes: Commitment matches IFRS S1 46(b)(ii); target details are described later but placeholders remain.

claims.claim_text: Where no IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard specifically applies to a sustainability-related risk or opportunity, the entity identifies applicable metrics by applying the approach in paragraphs 57–58.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "Where no IFRS... applies... we identify applicable metrics by applying the approach in paragraphs 57–58"
claims.support_notes: Directly mirrors IFRS S1 paragraph 47 requirement.

claims.claim_text: Disclosures include metrics associated with business models, activities or other common features that characterise participation in the entity's industry.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "Our disclosures include metrics associated with business models, activities or other common features..."
claims.support_notes: Commitment aligns with IFRS S1 paragraph 48; no industry-specific metrics are listed here.

claims.claim_text: The entity reports greenhouse gas emissions in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent (tCO2e) for the reporting period and provides comparative amounts for the preceding period.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "We report GHG emissions in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent (tCO2e)... and provide comparative amounts"
claims.support_notes: Comparative information commitment aligns with IFRS S1 comparative requirement; actual values are placeholders.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses Scope 1 emissions (tCO2e) for the reporting period and the preceding period.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: bullet list "Scope 1 emissions (tCO2e): [reporting period] [●]; [preceding period] [●]"
claims.support_notes: Metric is presented but amounts are placeholders; no explicit IFRS S2 GHG metric requirement IDs provided in the supplied supported_requirements list.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses Scope 2 emissions (location-based and market-based) in tCO2e for the reporting period and the preceding period.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: bullets for Scope 2 location-based and market-based with [●] placeholders
claims.support_notes: Presented with placeholders; no specific requirement IDs for Scope 2 in provided list.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses Scope 3 emissions (tCO2e) for the reporting period and the preceding period.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: bullet "Scope 3 emissions (tCO2e): [reporting period] [●]; [preceding period] [●]"
claims.support_notes: Presented with placeholders; no specific requirement IDs for Scope 3 in provided list.

claims.claim_text: When disclosing a metric taken from a source other than IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, the entity identifies the source and the metric taken.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "When we disclose a metric taken from a source other than IFRS... we identify: the source; and the metric taken."
claims.support_notes: Directly aligns with IFRS S1 paragraph 49.

claims.claim_text: For GHG emissions metrics, the source is identified as a placeholder (e.g., the GHG Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard), and the metrics taken are Scope 1, Scope 2 (location-based and market-based) and Scope 3 emissions in tCO2e.
entities: GHG Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "For our GHG emissions metrics, the source is: [●] (for example, the GHG Protocol...)"
claims.support_notes: Meets structure but the actual source is not specified (placeholder [●]).

claims.claim_text: For any entity-developed metric disclosed, the entity provides the metric definition (including derivation/adjustments and differences vs the source), whether it is absolute/ratio/qualitative, whether it is third-party validated (and by whom), and the calculation method/inputs including significant assumptions and limitations.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "For any entity-developed metric we disclose:" bullet list
claims.support_notes: Directly maps to IFRS S1 paragraph 50(a)-(d); no entity-developed metric examples provided.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses information about targets set to monitor progress towards strategic goals and any targets required by law or regulation.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "We disclose information about: the targets we have set...; and any targets we are required to meet by law or regulation."
claims.support_notes: High-level commitment corresponds to IFRS S1 paragraph 51 overall; detailed target fields are listed next.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity discloses: the metric used; the specific quantitative or qualitative target; the period; the base period (year and value); milestones/interim targets; performance against the target in the reporting period including trend commentary; and any revisions and reasons (or that there were no revisions).
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "For each target, we disclose:" bullet list
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 51(a)-(g); draft adds explicit 'year and value' for base period and 'or no revisions'.

claims.claim_text: The entity uses an internal carbon price in decision-making and discloses how it is applied and the internal carbon price per tCO2e including currency and scope of application.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "We use an internal carbon price... We disclose:" bullet list
claims.support_notes: No matching requirement IDs provided in the supplied supported_requirements list; disclosure fields are placeholders.

claims.claim_text: Internal carbon price is disclosed as: [currency] [●] per tCO2e; scope of application: [●]; application in decisions: [●].
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "Internal carbon price: [currency] [●] per tCO2e; scope..."
claims.support_notes: All values are placeholders; cannot be substantiated as an actual disclosed amount.

claims.claim_text: The entity applies consistent definitions and calculation methods for metrics and targets over time; if a metric is redefined or replaced, revised comparative information is presented unless impracticable, and the change and why it provides more useful information are explained.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "We apply consistent definitions... If we redefine or replace a metric..."
claims.support_notes: Aligns with IFRS S1 paragraph 52 and B52(a)-(c).

claims.claim_text: The entity provides comparative information for the preceding period for all amounts disclosed.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: "We provide comparative information for the preceding period for all amounts disclosed."
claims.support_notes: Directly aligns with IFRS S1 comparative information requirement.

claims.claim_text: When a disclosed metric amount is estimated and new information provides evidence of circumstances that existed in the preceding period, the entity revises the comparative amount (except as specified in paragraph B51), discloses the difference, and explains the reasons for the revision.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: final paragraph on estimated metrics and revisions
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 B50(a)-(c); B51 exception referenced but not included in provided requirements list.
